title: Block Map · 3D anchor
observed: Three-region layout: persistent layer/property rail, detailed labelled city scene, tabbed building inspector and bottom findings tray.
gap: Current map has working geometry but a different two-row shell, popovers, simplified inspector, repeating materials and no minimap or scene thumbnail.
build: Reproduce anchor proportions and controls; use one shared viewport with canonical selection, richer display assets, road labels, metric scale, render-derived thumbnails and real contextual routes.
data: Objects, geometry revisions, parcels, issues, utility evidence, source assets, session context.

title: Building Register · anchor
observed: Property-focused register with a dominant exploded building/floor view and supporting record, unit and evidence information.
gap: Standalone uses a record modal; it does not reproduce the register route or its inspection composition.
build: Bind the anchor layout to the same selected building, floor and space IDs; show genuine interior geometry where present and retain contextual return to the block.
data: Building/floor/space representations, relations, source-linked evidence and record state.

title: Plan Workspace · measure anchor
observed: Plan document workspace with drawing tools, visible dimensions, selected document context and measurement results.
gap: No calibrated document workspace exists in the standalone; a horizontal building cut is not document measurement.
build: Reuse product document/calibration services; match the anchor viewer/toolbars and persist measurements against source revision and calibration transform.
data: Original document revision, page, scale/alignment, frame, measured geometry and reviewer actions.

title: Block Map · 2D layers
observed: Cartographic 2D cadastral view with layers, property context, road/parcel labels, compass and scale.
gap: Current 2D mode is an orthographic view of the same 3D assets; it lacks this dedicated cartographic style and reference panel arrangement.
build: Compile the same canonical objects into 2D fills, boundaries and collision-managed labels; share visibility and selection with 3D.
data: Exact parcel/road/building rings, named features, render frame, layer visibility and scale.

title: Data Tools · import/export
observed: Source/format-oriented data tools over the map, with upload/export scopes and source handling.
gap: Current ZIP reader opens normalized.json; it does not run all illustrated format adapters or a full mapping/review workflow.
build: Connect existing intake to detect → map → validate → preview → review; enable only tested formats, preserve original bytes and reimport exports.
data: Source revisions, field mapping, frames/CRS, observations, normalized geometry and export selection.

title: Block Map · parcel inspector
observed: Property/parcel directory and a parcel-specific inspector with associated buildings and boundary context.
gap: Current picking is building-focused; the linked parcel opens text instead of a first-class selectable parcel view.
build: Give parcels independent picking/search and exact boundaries/holes; support multiple associated buildings and disputed links without guessing ownership.
data: Parcel identities, identifier assertions, polygon revisions, many-to-many relations and source claims.

title: Block Map · utilities/findings
observed: Utility-type layers, pipeline callouts, A–A′ section, categorized findings tray and detailed utility/clearance inspector.
gap: Current tubes are display alignments; there is no real utility inspector, section-plane workflow or qualified clearance rule.
build: Use exact authored network geometry and depth semantics; calculate sections/clearance from qualified inputs, link all panels to the same evidence.
data: Utility diameter/depth convention, benchmark, ground/foundation geometry, section plane, rule and input revisions.

title: Home · municipal workflow
observed: Welcome/entry page with workflow steps, five start actions, recent workspaces and recent plan cards.
gap: Filename says photos/history but the actual image is a dashboard. Current reference opens straight onto the map.
build: Reproduce the entry layout using real saved drafts/source previews; implement useful empty states and working contextual actions.
data: Workspace/session records, progress, timestamps, property refs and actual document thumbnails.

title: Register · scoped building view
observed: A building-specific register state with its own identity, floor/unit inspection and evidence context.
gap: Filename says start page, but this image is already scoped to a property; the current modal cannot replace it.
build: Keep a single register route with anchor-led structure and supported alternate inspection states, preserving object/floor selection.
data: Stable entity references, floors/spaces, geometry availability and linked source revisions.

title: Register · directory/start
observed: A directory/entry state for finding and opening registered properties, rather than only an in-building floor view.
gap: Filename says floors-and-units, but visible content is the register directory/start experience.
build: Make main Register navigation open this directory; property actions open the selected record while retaining the block context.
data: Searchable record summaries, dataset scope, status, pagination and contextual identifiers.

title: Workspace · state/component board
observed: Seventeen component/state panels covering workspace creation, documents, calibration, comparison, evidence, findings, history and related map data.
gap: This is a state board, not a single start screen. Most corresponding workflows are absent from the isolated prototype.
build: Implement these as states of existing workspace/map/register routes; avoid creating one disconnected page per panel.
data: Document/workspace identity, calibration, measurements, comparison inputs, processing outputs and revision history.

title: Board 01 · workflow details
observed: Fourteen panels: map layers, import/export, parcel/utility details, photos/history, properties/findings, floors/evidence/issues, measurement and calibration.
gap: Adds requirements not visible in the anchors, including utility profiles and multiple buildings per parcel.
build: Use anchor layouts as the stable shell; use the board to specify panel contents and missing interaction states.
data: Source-backed profiles, media, history, issue lifecycle, parcel relations and calibration.

title: Board 04 · 21-panel sequence
observed: Map, register and document-workspace progression, including upload organization, area/angle tools, calibration, comparison and build/review.
gap: Shows broad import/export and generation affordances that have not been proven by the current standalone.
build: Expose real processing state and reviewed output; align plan/model before comparison and test each enabled export by reimport.
data: Workflow state, source transforms, measured/derived geometry and validated exports.

title: Board 02 · 16-panel storyboard
observed: Basemap variants, layer opacity, staged source mapping, filtered property tables, utility/photos/history, floor tables and investigations.
gap: Alternative layouts conflict with the anchors; opacity/basemaps, searchable stateful tables and investigations are not unified.
build: Use these as alternate states within anchor-led routes; preserve schema/state across modes and provide offline basemap fallback.
data: Layer opacity, georeferenced assets, tables tied to live records, review status and investigation evidence.

title: Board 05 · detailed grid
observed: Dense aerial/cartographic map, file detection, multi-network utilities, street/site imagery, source evidence, measurement and AI-assisted comparison/build.
gap: Satellite-like appearance cannot come from plain extrusions alone; confidence bars and processing states cannot be copied as facts.
build: Separate display imagery/assets from analytical geometry; use only real inference outputs and qualify source placement/availability.
data: Raster transforms, source media, utility semantics, extraction candidates and reviewed geometry.

title: Board 03 · A/B/C states
observed: Map panels, nested utility layers, exploded register, PDF evidence, investigations, calibrated plan/model overlay and build-review checklist.
gap: Requires a common session and frame across screens; current map controls do not implement document calibration or general sections.
build: Share selection/session/geometry catalogs; make checklist and overlay results reflect actual validation and source revisions.
data: Versioned frames, document calibration, model/plan geometry, evidence and review state.

title: Investigation · property evidence
observed: A dedicated property investigation view combining mapped evidence, source context, review history and case actions.
gap: Current conflict modal reports geometry but is not a persistent investigation workflow.
build: Create/open cases from real findings, bind input geometry revisions, retain evidence and decisions, and return to the same map selection.
data: Investigation/case records, issue refs, source artifacts, revision-bound evidence and audit events.
